Draconic Illusionist Action - Invocation (Uprising). 'Legendary. Transform target ash you control into Dominia. Go again.'

GO AGAIN NOT AUTHORED: unconditional printed keyword (GoAgain in printed_keywords), fires from the card DB keywords field. Re-authoring it as a DSL effect is a defect per the implementation guide ('authoring [keywords] again is a defect, not thoroughness').

LEGENDARY NOT AUTHORED: deckbuilding/game-state restriction keyword handled by the engine via card DB keywords.

TRANSFORM (effect_types.py:3872-3977): reads 'from' (source token/subtype to consume), 'to' (resulting token slug), 'amount', 'up_to'. FROM 'ash' matches permanents via _norm_amt against slug/name/subtypes (lines 3911-3915). TO 'dominia' creates the dragon ally via create_token('dominia'). AMOUNT 1 (one ash consumed). UP_TO false: the card says 'target ash' (mandatory target, not 'up to'), per CR 8.5.36d if no ash exists the play does nothing at resolution.

TARGET FILTER for CR 1.8.5 legality: CONTROLS_TOKEN_TYPE token ash amount 1 checks whether the source card's controller controls >=1 ash in their permanents/equipment/weapon slots (condition_types.py:1725-1793). This gates playability: with no ash in play, the card cannot be played at all, matching the printed 'target ash you control'. This fixes the restriction-dropped finding on invoke_nekria_red and invoke_azvolai_red (.review/).

NEEDS A TOKEN DEFINITION: dominia.json exists in .drafts/ but not yet in json/tokens/. If the token JSON is not promoted before this card is tested, create_token will raise MissingCardImplementation.
